notes.title: "Fat Sheep Crisis II" is Now Officially Released with a 20% Launch Discount!
notes.content:
Dear players,
It's been a while! Over the past year, we have been fully dedicated to developing the second installment of the Fat Sheep series. Fat Sheep Crisis II now features online multiplayer functionality. Compared to the first game, our development process has been more refined, resulting in a higher level of polish and better optimization. We hope you’ll enjoy this sequel as much as we enjoyed creating it!

Easter Egg Unlock Methods in Fat Sheep Crisis:
FatSheep Friend: Talk to the crown-wearing sheep in the game 24 times.
Beautiful Chicken: Stay idle on the game’s start screen for 15 minutes until the screen turns completely red.

In Fat Sheep Crisis II, you can experience:
15 unique classes and 60 skills
15 difficulty levels
30 plugins
45 achievements
Over 20 different pieces of equipment
A wealth of both in-game and out-of-game progression options!
Dive into the thrill of multiplayer battles and enjoy the satisfaction of mowing down waves of enemies!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3292290/II/]Click here to go directly to the store[/url]

notes.title: V1.4- Version Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone, everyone has been waiting for a long time. We have created new modes and systems. If you encounter any problems or are dissatisfied with the gameplay, please respond within the community, and we will read your feedback every day!

[h3][b]New content[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New mode: Fat Sheep Dungeon. In this mode, materials required for strengthening weapons will be dropped, and Fat Sheep Prayer cannot be performed in this mode. After each wave ends, you can freely choose the attribute bonuses you want to obtain. As the wave number increases, the material produced by BOSS will become more and more.
[*] Weapon Enhancement System, now you can enhance your weapon, and every 10 levels of enhancement will earn an additional attribute. Different weapons of different qualities can enhance at different levels. If you are not satisfied with the additional attributes obtained, you can refresh them, which will incur a certain cost. If you have satisfactory entries, you can lock them to avoid being refreshed, but this will incur additional costs.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.34- Version Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this update has made adjustments to the game balance. If you encounter any problems or are dissatisfied with the gameplay, please respond within the community and we will read your feedback!

[h3][b]Change content[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][u]In this update, we have reduced the difficulty of some achievements. If your weapon did not achieve an achievement before, but after this update, it shows that the achievement has been completed and the 5 weapons required for the final weapon achievement have not been added, please bring this weapon to the map to kill a few monsters and pop up the achievement achievement pop-up window. [/u]
[*]For balance reasons, we have increased the CD for 'Return to Heaven' by 1 second, while reducing the invincibility time for 'Emergency Evasion' from 3 seconds to 2 seconds.
[*]For BOSS strength, we have reduced its health, damage reduction, movement speed, and attack to a certain extent.
[/list]

This is a temporary update patch. It will take some time for major version updates, and there should be some minor updates or patches during this period (* ^ ▽ ^ *)

notes.title: Fat Sheep Crisis is now officially on sale with 20% off for the first week!
notes.content:
Hello players on Steam. The version 1.0 of Fat Sheep Crisis is now officially on sale with 20% off for the first week!

We are a very small production team. During the more than one year of development, we have experienced a lot of difficulties. After overcoming all the obstacles along the way, we finally bring Fat Sheep Crisis to you! (^▽^). 

Here I would like to talk about some current issues and future development plans. 

Currently, the number of occupations in Fat Sheep Crisis is still small. When developing new occupations, the progress will be delayed due to problems with art resources. Each occupation has its own exclusive weapons, achievements and plugins. We work hard on each occupation to maintain occupational balance and avoid occupations that are too strong or too weak. Subsequently, we will speed up production and add more interesting occupations!

In terms of skills, there are currently a total of 24 skills, including 5 fire attributes, 5 ice attributes, 5 thunder attributes, 5 non-attributes, and 4 water attributes. As you can see, water attribute skills are still missing one, but we already have ideas and will add it soon. In the follow-up, in addition to these active skills, we will add passive skills for players to choose from. Passive skills will open up new gameplay, so stay tuned! 

Currently, the number of maps is not enough and the differences between maps are not large enough. Therefore, in the subsequent development, our goal is to add more maps and increase the differentiation between maps. We hope that diverse maps can bring fun to you. 

Finally, the number of plugins is not enough. In the future, we will add more distinctive plugins, not just to enhance the character's attributes, but also to bring new gameplay! 

Fat Sheep Crisis is the first time we have fully experienced the entire development cycle. From project establishment to launch, it has been an invaluable experience for us. If you encounter bugs and gameplay issues, please continue to give us effective feedback, which is very helpful to us. We will take your feedback seriously!

We hope you can find happiness in our game! (^o^)人(^o^)
